reference_single_head.label: Single-head transplant (L0H3 -> L0H1)
reference_single_head.description: seed0 L0H3 -> seed1 L0H1 (rows/cols of qkv/out only)
reference_single_head.note: Catastrophic failure; Procrustes alignment also failed (R2 < 0)

experiments.label: Whole L0 attention block (all 4 heads)
experiments.description: Replace seed1's L0 qkv_proj and out_proj with seed0's
experiments.hypothesis: If circuits are self-contained at the attention-layer level, accuracy should be preserved (near seed1 baseline).

experiments.label: Whole L0 block (attn + MLP + LayerNorms)
experiments.description: Replace seed1's entire L0 transformer block with seed0's
experiments.hypothesis: If circuits require attention+MLP together, this should work but Exp1 might fail.

experiments.label: Whole L0 block + final LayerNorm
experiments.description: Replace seed1's L0 block and ln_f with seed0's
experiments.hypothesis: Tests whether final LayerNorm mismatch matters.

experiments.label: Embeddings only (wte + wpe)
experiments.description: Replace seed1's token and position embeddings with seed0's
experiments.hypothesis: Embeddings alone shouldn't change induction accuracy much if the downstream weights adapt to the embedding basis.

experiments.label: Embeddings + L0 attention
experiments.description: Replace seed1's embeddings and L0 qkv/out with seed0's
experiments.hypothesis: Embeddings define the input basis for L0; transplanting both may allow L0 attention to work correctly in seed1's context.

experiments.label: Embeddings + L0 full block
experiments.description: Replace seed1's embeddings and entire L0 block with seed0's
experiments.hypothesis: Adding MLP and LayerNorms may help if L0 block needs its own basis.

experiments.label: All except L1 block (embed + L0 + ln_f)
experiments.description: Replace everything from seed1 except the L1 transformer block
experiments.hypothesis: Tests whether L1 is the bottleneck: if this works, L1 alone can adapt; if not, L1 is incompatible with seed0's L0 output.

experiments.label: Full transplant (all weights, sanity check)
experiments.description: Replace ALL seed1 weights with seed0's — should reproduce seed0 accuracy
experiments.hypothesis: This must reproduce seed0 baseline (~0.85). If it doesn't, the transplant machinery is broken.

failing_experiments: All except L1 block (embed + L0 + ln_f)
analysis.interpretation: CIRCUITS ARE GENUINELY SYSTEM-LEVEL. Only transplanting the complete network reproduces seed0 accuracy. No proper subset of weights is independently portable. The induction computation is an emergent property of the full weight configuration — there is no 'module' that can be surgically extracted and re-implanted. The circuit is truly system-level, consistent with the Procrustes alignment failure (R² < 0): the two networks don't share any common representational subspace that would allow partial reuse.

summary_table.scope: All except L1 block (embed + L0 + ln_f)
